notes: Section 7.11 Current Ratio >= 1.50 at any time; Section 7.12 Minimum Consolidated Net Worth >= $5,750,000 at any time (30-day cure). Section 6.10 Minimum Cash is a formula (greater of six months of projected burn or six months of negative net income) with no fixed number, so it is optional with a null threshold. The 'Operating Milestone' (30% revenue growth, 7.5% EBITDA margin) gates a later tranche and is not a covenant.
